name: KERHUPERT (holding of Kermasport)
note: Brest SARL (SIREN 990088437, 69 rue Amiral Romain-Desfosses, Brest) that is Président de SAS of KERMASPORT (SIREN 489019547), the company behind Le Rond Central; its gérants are Geoffrey Julien Louis Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Claire Hubert-Pons — the Hubert family. No state or fund stake found.
